summary: ACES Delta is the canonical manager-level hydrogen storage platform, with Advanced Clean Energy Storage I as its linked first project company. Chevron controls the platform through Magnum and Mitsubishi Power Americas remains the minority co-owner. Haddington Energy Partners III is a former indirect owner through Magnum; Haddington ESP I retains managed construction equity in ACES I. GIC, Ontario Teachers, AIMCo and Manulife are ESP I investors only and must not appear as direct ACES owners.
nonblockingDisclosureGaps: Exact Chevron and Mitsubishi platform ownership percentages are not publicly disclosed.
The precise Haddington ESP I construction-equity instrument and ACES I percentage are not publicly disclosed.
Exact ACES Delta formation and Chevron legal closing dates are not publicly disclosed.
